title: Q3 engagement cadence and ask framework
content:
Purpose:
This is a working playbook for Q3 company-wide engagement: one doc to coordinate the executive update, OKR alignment pre-work, the all-company meeting run-of-show, and the feedback loop post-event.

Context and why this exists (notes to self):
- We need fewer ad-hoc asks in all-hands and clearer follow-ups.
- Exec updates are drifting long; target is 12–15 minutes total for exec slate + 10 minutes for cross-functional highlights.
- We have early Dedicated and Private deployments that need specific shout-outs (customer wins).
- Primary audiences: full company (eng, product, go-to-market, ops), with a lightweight read-ahead for leads.

High-level timeline (Q3 planning window):
- Week -3 (pre-read prep): collect exec bullets and customer highlights (owners: execs + comms) — due 2026-03-18
- Week -2 (slides draft): comms consolidates, feedback loop with product and eng — due 2026-03-25
- Week -1 (rehearsal): 1x 45-minute runthrough with execs + 1x 30-minute tech dry run — rehearsal 2026-03-30
- Day 0 (town hall): run-of-show and live Q&A — 2026-04-02
- Day +2 (follow-up): publish minutes, action tracker, and short pulse survey — 2026-04-04

Primary goals and OKR touchpoints (draft rubric):
- Goal: Make company priorities tangible + reduce ambiguity around Q3 resource allocation.
- OKR touchpoints to highlight in exec update (pick 3):
  - Serving runtime: reduce median generation latency by 15% for 2k token workloads (owner: eng-serving-runtime)
  - Redwood Dedicated: onboard 5 new dedicated customers or convert 2 pilots to committed contracts (owner: sales-dedicated)
  - Private deployments: close 1 on-prem POC with SOC2+/HSM requirement (owner: solutions-eng)
  - Platform economics: reduce per-token inference cost for common chat traffic by 12% via batching and quantization configs (owner: optimize)
content_2:
Agenda (target 60 minutes):
- 0:00–0:05 — Welcome, housekeeping, context (CEO)
- 0:05–0:20 — Exec slate (3 execs, 5 min each): top 3 signals + ask(s)
- 0:20–0:30 — Product highlight: shipping cadence & notable model onboarding (PM)
- 0:30–0:40 — Customer highlight & success story (CS/SE)
- 0:40–0:50 — Metrics snapshot and roadmap health (FP&A + Eng Metrics)
- 0:50–1:00 — Live Q&A (moderator collects Slack questions, triages)

Slide/exec update checklist (working):
- Each slide must contain: 1-line headline, 2–3 supporting bullets, 1 explicit ask (if relevant), and a follow-up owner.
- Limit slides per speaker to 2.
- Use the standardized metric card (P50/P95 latency, per-token cost, active Dedicated pools, churn rate, MRR delta).
- Color/brand: use company template from the linked slide deck.

Rehearsal & logistics (notes):
- Required rehearsals: CEO + Exec slate full runthrough (45m). Product + CS short tech dry run (30m).
- AV checks: 30 min before. Confirm captions + recording on.
- Recording owner: comms ops (Sofia). Post-edit trimmed 6–8 minute summary for Slack.

Pre-reads and distribution plan:
- Pre-read packet (1 page): 3 bullets per exec, 2 metrics cards, 1 customer highlight, 1 critical ask per team. Target length < 1 page.
- Distribution: email to company + pinned Slack to #company-announces 48h before event.
- Optional: run a short 3-question pulse survey in the pre-read asking what people hope to hear.

RSVP, crowd engagement, and breakout idea bank (rough):
- RSVP: use internal form (link in linked_artifacts) to collect questions and suggested shoutouts.
- Engagement: live poll on top 2 cross-team friction points; anonymous icebox for follow-ups.
- Breakouts: prep 3 optional cross-functional micro-sessions after the main event (30 min) — topics: infra cost controls, customer success onboarding, product roadmap Q&A.

Post-event follow-up and action tracker (template):
- Publish: 1) recording, 2) 1-page minutes, 3) action tracker with owners and due dates.
- Action tracker fields: ask, owner, due date, status. (we will use a shared sheet for live tracking).
- Pulse: 5-question survey post-event (engagement, clarity, actionability, length, one improvement).

Open questions / unresolved decisions (to resolve in planning sync):
- Should we maintain the 60-minute cadence or expand to 75 minutes for Q3? Pros/cons in comments.
- Are we highlighting a customer from Dedicated or Private? Which story is most ready and has written permission?
- How aggressive do we want the public-facing messaging around cost reductions to be prior to benchmarks locked?

Risk register (short):
- Exec overrun: mitigation = strict pre-read enforcement + timekeeper assigned.
- Last-minute data changes: mitigation = freeze data 24h before rehearsal; FP&A sign-off.
- Low attendance: mitigation = manager-level reminders + incentives for team participation (retro points).

Measurement plan & success criteria (draft):
- Success if: 70%+ of respondents to post-event pulse report increased clarity on Q3 priorities.
- Secondary signals: >60% live attendance, >25% of attendees respond to pulse, and <10 action items marked as blocked after 2 weeks.
- Leading metrics to track in runbook: recruitment of volunteers for follow-ups, number of follow-up tickets created, number of cross-team POCs started within 30 days.

Execution owners (first pass):
- Program lead: Claire Nguyen (company-ops)
- Comms + slide consolidation: Sofia Martinez
- Rehearsal coordinator: Ravi Patel
- Metrics and FP&A: Maya Lopez
- AV/recording: Ethan Brooks

Notes-to-self / informal bits (tone: rough):
- Might want a short "what success looks like" call with each exec 1 week out — helps tighten asks.
- Keep the applause meter low; prioritize signal over cheer.
- Seed a couple of pre-submitted questions so Q&A isn't empty.

Next steps (immediate):
1) Owners confirm slides and asks by 2026-03-18.
2) Comms to assemble pre-read and distribute by 2026-03-20.
3) Rehearsal schedule to be finalized by 2026-03-22.

Appendix (templates and micro-forms):
- Exec update template headline: "Signal: [1-line]; Impact: [why it matters in Q3]; Ask: [explicit ask + owner]"
- Action tracker sample row: "Reduce batch latency by 12% — eng-serving-runtime — 2026-04-30 — in_progress"

Slack channels and references (quick):
- #company-announces, #company-townhall-ops, #eng-serving-runtime, #product-hosted-api

Raw references / links used during planning:

-- end of draft playbook --

(If you're reading this as an owner: add your slide bullets to the shared deck and ping me in #company-townhall-ops if you need help boiling bullets down.)
